reviews.author: Pres

reviews.title: Beautiful and easy to control
reviews.comment: Very easy to install, and keeps my computer nice and cool even with the majority of the case being glass. Has thermal-paste pre-applied to the part that attaches to the motherboard on top of the CPU. Wasn't expecting that, so I didn't need to buy any thermal paste. Mounting screws were included. I have it connected with iCUE link control panel and it interfaces seamlessly with the rest of my corsair fans. I've never had lights in my PC before, so this has been a real treat. Would buy the larger size next time, the case was purchased after I already had the cooler so it's a little smaller than it should've been but no fault of the product or description itself. Just me. Love it!
reviews.author: Evasaurus
